notes.title: Tips: Description of the number of search matches
notes.content:
Respected players:
Thank you for your attention and support to the Bang Bang car, Due to our global network of many Poorly considered, In the "multiplayer game-search game" number of does not meet system requirements, Leading to the beginning of the game difficult, Temporarily set the number of contestants to reach 3 people can start, If you can not start, please invite friends to join the team after the search game experience game.
We are modifying the search method and will be repaired in the next update patch.

notes.title: Early Access Description
notes.content:
The following is our explanation of this open version.
For a game designed for casual sports,Smooth network connection is essential,
But we are such an independent developer,There is no ability to ask a professional test team to help us verify this.
Thanked the steam provides this publicly game before the official release window for us, so I implore you to help us check the smoothness of the game and synchronization of network connectivity.
I also hope that we can give valuable suggestions to help us improve the game step by step.
Here, heartfelt thanks to the majority of players!
